simulation.common_random_numbers_note: All four price engines use the same aligned base seed; WACC shocks are independent and reused exactly across models.

path_grid.resampling: every 13th fine step to 20 operating quarters

common_scenario_start.source_definition: Q2 2026 average realized gold price used only as the shared level anchor

common_scenario_drift.method: Team 8 U.S. Treasury Nelson-Siegel-Svensson curve converted to integral-preserving forward rates
common_scenario_drift.measure: common conditional risk-neutral scenario drift; not estimated physical expected return

conditional_bridge.label: conditional transfer of GLD/Q distributional shape to gold USD/oz
conditional_bridge.gld_to_gold_level_conversion: NOT_PERFORMED; engines share an independently sourced Barrick realized-price level anchor
conditional_bridge.interpretation: Controlled research sensitivity of distributional shape only; not fair value, target price or investment recommendation.

common_non_gold_layers.production_and_cost_note: Barrick actuals cover 2026Q1-Q2; the frozen Team 4 forecast begins at 2026Q3 and remains explicitly labelled.
common_non_gold_layers.team4_demonstrator_excluded: Team 4 NSS, IV, GBM, simulated gold prices and illustrative EBITDA valuation are not inputs to this experiment.

selection_basis.in_sample_result: Heston has the lowest CC64 implied-volatility RMSE (49.4881 bp).
selection_basis.out_of_sample_result: Full Bates-Hawkes has the lowest date-equal rolling OOS implied-volatility RMSE (65.0507 bp) over 30 origins and 4,667 common forecasts.
selection_basis.basis: Primary structural sensitivity selected on rolling OOS ranking, with all simpler models reported and the distinct in-sample ranking disclosed.
selection_basis.caveat: Model comparison is conditional and does not validate a physical gold forecast or a target price.
